content:
#15 Thanks, now it works for me.

To sum up, here is the installation instructions for Firefox on Windows:

  1. Download the Stylus add-on for Firefox at addons.mozilla.org/en-GB/firefox/addon/styl-us

  2. go to userstyles.world/style/15519/nlab-dark, scroll down to find and click on the button “Install”

  3. in the top left of the page that appears, click on “Install style”

  4. after this a couple of new buttons appear, click on “Manage”

  5. in the list that appears, check “nLab dark”.
